#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Don't Starve Together world — generated by provision().
# One process per level: Caves (if enabled) runs in the background, the surface
# world ("Master") in the foreground. Settings live in the cluster folder:
#   <ROOT>/home/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/gd_test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join password in step with the one set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/home/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/gd_test/cluster.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, pw = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
t = re.sub(r"(?m)^cluster_password = .*$", lambda m: "cluster_password = " + pw, t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/dst/bin64" || exit 1
env --default-signal=INT ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -persistent_storage_root "<ROOT>/home/.klei" -conf_dir DoNotStarveTogether -cluster gd_test -shard Caves &
exec ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -persistent_storage_root "<ROOT>/home/.klei" -conf_dir DoNotStarveTogether -cluster gd_test -shard Master
